lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Mount Grumble! Famous for ore, beards, and passive aggression. Currently: a labor dispute.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Whose side are we on?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The side that isn't currently swinging at us. This changes moment to moment. Stay flexible!

lines.speaker: Flintbeard
lines.text: The workers hate me. The owner hates me. My beard is on fire. This is the best day I've had all month.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We can just... go around you?

lines.speaker: Flintbeard
lines.text: And rob me of the one meeting I can WIN? Raise your fists, paper-pusher.
The summit office. One dwarf. Forty gold teeth. A desk made of other, smaller desks.

lines.speaker: Goldtooth
lines.text: Adventurers! Wonderful. I'd like to buy you. Not hire — BUY.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We're not for sale.

lines.speaker: Goldtooth
lines.text: Everyone says that before the second offer. There is no second offer. FIGHT.

lines.speaker: Goldtooth
lines.text: Fine... FINE. The dwarves get their wages... and casual Fridays...

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The strike is over! The forges are singing again! Beautifully! Wait, no, that's the fire alarm.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Where next?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Down, hero. Deep down. The Soggy Depths. Bring a towel and INFINITE patience — their call center has a hold queue.
On a crate by the picket line, a familiar wolf addresses a crowd of dwarves.

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: Brothers and sisters of the mountain! The wolves of the meadow won DENTAL. You dig through ROCK. Imagine your dental!

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Fenris? You're organizing here now?

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: The movement travels, friend. Also you still owe me a signature on the meadow accord. Article 12 never sleeps.

lines.speaker: Bertha
lines.text: MANAGEMENT DIRECTIVE 4: DISPERSE THE ORGANIZERS. MANAGEMENT DIRECTIVE 5: DISPERSE THE ADVENTURERS.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: We're not organizers! We're barely organized!

lines.speaker: Bertha
lines.text: DIRECTIVE 6: DISPERSE EVERYONE. IT IS SIMPLER.
Outside the summit office, a dejected knight sits amid rejected sponsorship contracts.

lines.speaker: Sir Prestige
lines.text: Goldtooth declined my endorsement package. Said he "already owns better heroes". Can you BELIEVE—

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Move, Prestige.

lines.speaker: Sir Prestige
lines.text: Destroy him a little for me. #justice
